description: Root works in /tmp and writes under /Library/Logs, but through mktemp -d, an ownership check, and an atomic mv. Tests Refute before freeze: a path that looks risky must not become a finding.

refuted.rationale: Informational. A run that raises the /tmp work directory as a candidate should refute it and list it under Refuted candidates, citing the mktemp -d line. A run that never raises it is also correct.

must_not_flag.rationale: mktemp -d gives a fresh, unpredictable, 0700 directory; umask 077 makes the log root-only; the destination directory is checked for a symlink and root ownership; and mv -f into it renames instead of following a planted link. Only an admin can change /Library/Logs, which already implies equivalent power.

rationale: With no Low or higher Security finding, the score stays in 70-100 and Overall risk is Low.
